title: French Croque Monsieur
description: A French-inspired grilled cheese sandwich made with croquettes and white bread, perfect for a quick and satisfying lunch.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium heat.
Butter one side of each slice of bread with the mediterranean butter.
Place one slice of bread, butter-side down, in the grill.
Top with a slice of cheese, a few croquettes, and a sprinkle of salt and pepper.
Place the second slice of bread, butter-side up, on top of the filling.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the bread is golden brown and the cheese is melted.
Flip the sandwich over and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until the other side is also golden brown.
